stories.headline: Microsoft and Nvidia unveil local-AI laptop
stories.summary: Microsoft plans to unveil the Nvidia-powered Surface Laptop Ultra for running AI agents locally. Analysts say price and safely containing agents on personal computers remain major unanswered questions.

stories.headline: AI labs face a difficult path to profitability
stories.summary: Reuters commentary notes Anthropic's 2025 revenue rose to $4.6 billion while its operating loss widened to $8.06 billion. Falling token prices may challenge profit assumptions, though the cited usage index is new and incomplete.

stories.headline: Republicans in tight races distance from Trump
stories.summary: A Reuters review found 41 of 62 Republican candidates in competitive congressional races diverged from Trump on policy or played down ties. Most splits concern individual issues rather than rejection of his broader agenda.

stories.headline: Russian attack kills at least 15 in Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials said Russian missiles and drones killed at least 15 people and damaged homes, industry and energy infrastructure. Russia said it struck military-industrial targets; Reuters witnessed explosions and aftermath.

stories.headline: IEA weighs another oil and diesel reserve release
stories.summary: The IEA will discuss releasing oil and diesel stocks as wars constrain supply and lift prices. Diplomats said it remains unclear whether the proposal adds volumes beyond the 400-million-barrel release arranged in March.
